text: Looking uncovers detail: wherever you look, the world reveals finer structure
description: A core experience goal: looking around should feel like discovering. The periphery stays abstract and coarse; where the gaze rests, the generator adds detail that then stays (it is reprojected with high certainty), so the world gets richer the more you look at it. This turns the foveation and compute limits into the feeling of the game. Uses eye tracking, the detail levels and the per-pixel certainty.

status.comment: focus fader (ca745ef) + eye gaze: XR_EXT_eye_gaze_interaction enabled when offered (Valve's Steam Frame docs name this extension for eye tracking), gaze pose -> world point 50 m out -> per-eye centred coords in the uniform `gaze`; resolve.frag centres the focus boost there (view centre when untracked). Verified on Monado: extension offered, binding accepted, renders 13.4 ms/frame. Human step: on the Frame (eye tracking enabled), set focus ~5-10: does detail gather where you look and feel like discovering?
